status.summary: UFC bantamweight champion. He took the title from Merab Dvalishvili at UFC 323 (Dec 6, 2025; 49-46, 49-46, 48-47) and kept it in the trilogy at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi (Oct 24, 2026; 48-47 on all three cards). Yahoo's headline called it a come-from-behind win. He has won five straight since 2024. On Oct 25, 2026 Dana White named Song Yadong and Sean O'Malley as the contenders. Betting headlines had Yan favoured in an O'Malley rematch. On Oct 30, 2026, flyweight champion Joshua Van named Yan as a possible future opponent. No booking was found. UFC record 13-4 per ufcstats; one of the losses is a 2021 DQ.
status.title: UFC bantamweight champion

signature: accurate punches from both stances: 55% sig accuracy career and 57% time-decayed, vs a 45.6% bantamweight average (fighters.json)
round-5 surges: 52 of 88 sig strikes in R5 of UFC 333, and 38 of 63 in R5 of UFC 323 (ufcstats)
head kick KO of Urijah Faber, R3 0:43, 2019 (ufcstats: 'Kick to Head At Distance')
ground-and-pound finish of Jose Aldo in round 5 for the vacant title, 2020 (ufcstats: 'Punches to Head On Ground')
reactive takedowns when needed: 7 of 7 vs Aljamain Sterling (2021), 6 of 13 vs O'Malley (2022), 5 of 9 vs Dvalishvili (2025)
weaknesses: slow first rounds: in five-round fights he lands far less in R1 than later (pace 1.00 / 1.29 / 1.58 / 2.03 / 2.42 vs a bantamweight prior of 1.00 / 1.32 / 1.32 / 1.37 / 1.53), and at UFC 333 the data point to Dvalishvili banking rounds 1-2 (5 of 19 takedowns while Yan landed 23 sig strikes)

is out-thrown: opponents attempt 10.8 sig strikes per minute against his 9.4 (career), and 11.9 vs 8.9 decayed, which leaves close cards (split-decision losses to Sterling in 2022 and O'Malley in 2022)
can be ridden on top by a control wrestler: Sterling held 8:31 of control in the 2022 rematch, and Dvalishvili out-landed him 147-75 in their first fight (2023, 50-45 x3)
knockdown rate has fallen to 0.14 per 15 min (decayed) from 0.49 career; his last KO/TKO win was Aldo in 2020
DQ loss for an illegal knee to a grounded Sterling (UFC 259, 2021)
style.summary: A compact switch-stance boxer who wins on accuracy, defence and a late-fight surge rather than raw output. He is hard to take down (88% takedown defence career) and can wrestle when he needs to. In both 2025-26 wins over Dvalishvili he lost the early rounds and then out-landed him heavily from round 3 on. He has never been stopped in the UFC and has been knocked down once.

moves.notes: Weights are relative within each target group, as src/director.js uses them: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1. spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for occasional specials. fighters.json time-decayed attempt split is 80.8% head, 10.8% body and 8.4% leg (landed 70.9/16.1/13.0). The bantamweight average is 76.2/14.1/9.7, so he is head-heavy, a little light to the body and about average to the legs. The head group is spread across straight punches, hooks and uppercuts for a switch-stance boxer. ufcstats shows 83% of his career attempts at distance, which keeps overhand low. headkick 0.06 reflects the Faber head-kick KO (ufcstats). knee 0.06 reflects documented knee use (the 2021 DQ for a knee to a grounded Sterling). The body and leg internal splits, spinning 0.02 and elbow 0.02 are unsourced defaults, not scouting findings. Web scouting pages could not be opened in this pass.

engine_notes.note: Takedown defence is 87.7% career (28 of 227 opponent attempts landed) and 89.4% decayed, vs a 65.7% bantamweight average. Dvalishvili went 2 of 29 at UFC 323 and 5 of 58 at UFC 333 (0 of 39 in rounds 3-5).

Strong late surge in five-round fights: landed-per-minute pace by round is 1.00 / 1.29 / 1.58 / 2.03 / 2.42 of round 1 over 8 five-round fights (about 40 minutes per round in the sample). The bantamweight prior is 1.00 / 1.32 / 1.32 / 1.37 / 1.53.
He is hard to hit cleanly: opponents land 39.9% of sig attempts on him (career) vs a 45.6% league average, and 32.9% of head attempts vs 37.1%.
Knocked down once in 17 UFC fights (John Dodson, 2019) and never stopped. All four losses went the distance or ended by DQ.
Power has faded. He has 10 career knockdowns (0.49 per 15 min) but only 0.14 per 15 min decayed, and five straight decision wins since 2024.
